title: lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA 最小 Rank（历史 T-LoRA key）
title_en: lulynx Progressive-Rank LoRA Minimum Rank (historical T-LoRA key)

standard.summary: lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA 的最小动态 rank；历史字段名仍为 tlora_min_rank。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The minimum dynamic rank of the lulynx progressive-rank LoRA; the historical field name is still tlora_min_rank.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 全局训练进度 rank schedule 的下限。仅在历史 network_module=networks.tlora / canonical lulynx progressive-rank mapping 时生效。

advanced_en.principle: Lower bound of the global training-progress rank schedule. Only effective with legacy network_module=networks.tlora / the canonical lulynx progressive-rank mapping.
